import subprocess, sys, json, random
GOOD = {"version":1,"n":4,"capacity":[2,2,1,3],
        "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":2,"label":"a"},
                 {"u":0,"v":2,"ping_us":3,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
                 {"u":1,"v":3,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"},
                 {"u":2,"v":3,"ping_us":2,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
        "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":9,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,
                   "drop_ping":[1],"drop_ack":[2]},
                  {"launch_us":4,"timeout_us":3,"host_delay_us":2,"drop_host_ack":True,
                   "drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
base=json.dumps(GOOD).encode()
rng=random.Random(5); fails=0; n=0
def chk(data):
    global fails,n
    n+=1
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
    ok = p.returncode in (0,2) and len(p.stderr)==0
    if ok:
        try:
            v=json.loads(p.stdout)
            if p.returncode==2 and v!={"error":"invalid-input"}: ok=False
            if p.returncode==0 and set(v)!={"rounds","metrics","classes","summary"}: ok=False
        except Exception: ok=False
    if not ok:
        fails+=1; print("FAIL", p.returncode, p.stdout[:80], p.stderr[-200:])
for i in range(300):
    t=bytearray(base)
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,4)):
        t[rng.randrange(len(t))]=rng.randrange(256)
    chk(bytes(t))
s=list(json.dumps(GOOD))
for i in range(300):
    t=list(s)
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3)):
        pos=rng.randrange(len(t))
        if rng.random()<0.5: t[pos]=rng.choice('{}[]",:0123456789.eE-+ \\t\n')
        else: del t[pos]
    chk("".join(t).encode())
print("mutation cases",n,"fails",fails)
PYEOF
